channel.title: JLT Agent Wins (LinkedIn)
channel.description: Agent Wins — JLT agent milestones, LinkedIn Business edition

item.title: Agent Win — Francesca
item.description:
Francesca has been building her travel business within JLT since launching Travel by Francesca in October 2025.
In that time, she has booked 29 holidays worth £121,000… learning suppliers, destinations, booking systems and social media from a standing start and turning that learning into a working business.
What stands out is the range of ground she has covered in a short space of time… supplier training, destination research, systems mastery and marketing, each picked up and put straight to work.
Within JLT, this is exactly what strong foundations look like… an agent building steadily, supported by real training and real systems.
Huge congratulations, Francesca. Here's to what's next.

item.title: Agent Win — Sophie Wilkin
item.description:
Sophie Wilkin was selected by Royal Caribbean to join the pre-sailing of their newest ship, Legend of the Seas, ahead of the ship's maiden voyage in July.
An invitation like this speaks to reputation as much as timing… a genuine vote of confidence from a major cruise line. And it was Sophie's first cruise.
In her own words: "Shocked, scared and feeling very grateful!"
That mix of ambition and honesty about the nerves is exactly what we value within JLT. It takes real confidence to say yes to something this big, especially as a first outing.
Congratulations, Sophie.

item.title: Agent Win — Mark Heath
item.description:
Mark Heath made his first JLT booking on 1st July 2025. A year on, he has passed £200,000 in gross holiday sales.
Sixty-three bookings, and his year-one target reached three weeks early… all built alongside a full-time job that already runs around 55 hours a week. The late nights, early mornings and weekends are right there in the numbers.
His goal was a simple one: enough commission to fund his own family holidays. This summer he is taking the kids to Walt Disney World in Orlando, paid for by the business he has built.
Consistency, not luck. That is what building a travel business within JLT looks like.
Congratulations Mark… richly deserved.
